title: The judges of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Sanhedrin 17b, the designation refers to Rav Pappa bar Shmuel. The judges are also mentioned in Ketubot 80a.

notes.text: The supplied text says רב פפא שמואל without a connector or patronymic marker. Its singular “he” also conflicts with the collective heading and later plural.

The earlier local note’s singular-versus-collective concern is qualified by the saved named Davidson Sanhedrin 17b paragraph: it explicitly identifies “the judges of Pumbedita” as the single Rav Pappa bar Shmuel. This supplies a patronymic comparison and explains a singular referent, but the frozen notice omits בר; its letters and Ketubot 80a reference remain as supplied.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. I, p. 334) has the heading “The judges of Pumbedita” and reads “Rav Pappa bar Shmuel.” The supplied Hebrew omits the heading and the word bar. Sanhedrin 17b identifies Rav Pappa bar Shmuel by this collective designation. Ketubot 80a uses it for those reporting an action by Rav Yehuda, without naming them individually in that passage.
